subject: CBD kickoff — fixing tail-class accuracy on long-tailed workloads
body:
Hi Santiago,

Kicking off the Class-Balanced Distillation effort. Three internal classification workloads have textbook long-tail problems — great head-class numbers, embarrassing tail. Our published CBD recipe (BMVC 2021) is a two-stage approach: stage one trains teachers with vanilla and augmented setups, stage two distills into a student with class-balanced sampling. It beat prior long-tail methods on ImageNet-LT and iNaturalist18, so we have a strong prior it transfers.

Goal for Feb 16 – Jun 1: reproduce published numbers to validate our harness, then apply to the two highest-priority internal workloads with a go/no-go quality bar of +5 tail accuracy at <1 head regression.

Efficiency angle for the OKR: better tail accuracy means fewer manual review escalations, which is a measurable cost line.

Santiago — staffing + compute plan when ready.

Zofia
